calls.head: The Bruins want Pastrňák away from the big guns
calls.body: At home, the Bruins keep sending Pastrňák’s line (Peterka, Zacha and Pastrňák) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Marco Sturm has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Predators’ fourth line is Pinchuk, Wood and Höglander.

calls.head: The Predators get in close, the Bruins shoot from distance
calls.body: On shots from in close, Nashville is near the top of the league, but Boston is near the bottom. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Predators to do more of their damage around the net.

surprises.head: Boston hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Boston’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 25, against their usual 104 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 450 games. That’s rarer than once a season for any one team.

surprises.head: A shutout for Michael DiPietro
surprises.body: DiPietro stopped all 28 shots, worth 3.1 expected goals. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 70 starts.

surprises.head: Boston got the good looks
surprises.body: Boston’s shots at 5-on-5 had a 9.6% chance of scoring on the average shot, against their usual 6.6% (about 6.3% against Nashville) and a league average of 6.4%. A team strays this far about once every 60 games.

story.head: DiPietro shuts out the Predators
paras: The Predators will want to forget this one fast. Casey Mittelstadt got the scoring started for the Bruins early in the first, and Elias Lindholm made it 2-0 on the power play late in the period. David Pastrňák stretched the lead to 3-0 midway through the second. JJ Peterka made it 4-0 late in the period, and Mark Kastelic stretched the lead to 5-0 midway through the third. Pastrňák scored again with five minutes left to make it 6-0. Charlie McAvoy finished with four assists, and Pastrňák added two assists for a four-point night.

The Bruins carried the play, and got the result to match. Michael DiPietro made 28 saves for his first NHL shutout. Justus Annunen allowed six goals on 31 shots for the Predators. The Bruins improved to 8-2-1, and the Preds dropped to 3-3-3.
